validity.recommendation: Reclassify / merge: this is almost certainly the Abqaiq(Shedgum)-Yanbu NGL line recorded as dry 'Gas'. Verify against P3962/P3966 (East-West Gas, Abqaiq->Yanbu) and the existing GEM Abqaiq-Yanbu NGL page; likely a duplicate/misclassification of the same physical corridor.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: A pipeline corridor from Abqaiq/Shedgum (Eastern Province) west to Yanbu (Red Sea / Al Madinah) is heavily documented in independent sources, so a physical asset exists. HOWEVER the SPECIFIC entity recorded here ('A47-Yanbu Gas Pipeline', 966 km, dia 42/48/56 in) has NO independent trace: the label 'A47' appears in zero non-GEM sources I could find (Aramco, news, trade press, offshore-technology, MEED/Argaam), and the exact figure '966 km' likewise appears in no independent source. The name and length are GEM-only artifacts. CLASSIFICATION (primary concern): the long-haul Abqaiq/Shedgum->Yanbu line of this scale is fundamentally an NGL pipeline, not a dry-gas transmission line. Techint (operator of record for the original line) describes the ~1,166 km Shedgum-Yanbu line built ~1978; Argaam, offshore-technology and the 2017 EIA all describe the Shedgum/Abqaiq->Yanbu line as carrying NGL/ethane as petrochemical feedstock for Jubail/Yanbu ('largest NGL pipeline' per EIA). The 585 km / 30 in figure cited by Argaam is the SHY-1 NGL expansion. None of these describe a dry-gas trunk of 966 km with diameters 42/48/56 in. So Fuel='Gas' is very likely a misclassification of an NGL line. DUPLICATE: GEM already separately tracks (a) the East-West Gas Pipeline Abqaiq->Yanbu as P3962 (1200 km, 48 in) and P3966 (821 km), and (b) a standalone 'Abqaiq-Yanbu NGL pipeline' wiki page. P1897's 966 km / 42,48,56 in overlaps that same Abqaiq->Yanbu corridor, so it is likely a relabel/segment double-count of one of those rather than a distinct fifth Abqaiq->Yanbu line. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100% is correct and well corroborated (Aramco/Techint/offshore-tech all attribute Abqaiq->Yanbu lines to Saudi Aramco) - that single field is fine. ENDPOINTS: StartLocation is blank in GEM; only StartCountry/EndCountry = Saudi Arabia are recorded - endpoints (Abqaiq/Shedgum -> Yanbu) are undocumented in the row and should be filled if the entity is retained. Net: do not silently pass. Treat as a classification + likely-duplicate concern pending a human decision on whether to reclassify to NGL, merge into P3962/P3966 or the NGL page, or delete as a GEM-only spurious entity.

summary: P1897 'A47-Yanbu Gas Pipeline' (966 km, 42/48/56 in): name+length are GEM-only (no independent trace); the Abqaiq/Shedgum->Yanbu line at this scale is an NGL line, not dry gas, and overlaps P3962/P3966 + the GEM Abqaiq-Yanbu NGL page -> classification + likely-duplicate concern; only Owner=Saudi Aramco is solid.
